name: Shoshone River — Willwood Dam to Hwy 295
blurb: Shoshone River: sections between Wyoming Game and Fish Department river access points.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Willwood Dam (Shoshone): exact agency facility pin. Take-out Highway 295 (Willwood Rd) (Shoshone): exact agency facility pin. Wyoming: next to private land the streambed is private — no anchoring, wading or getting out without landowner permission; floating through is legal. Watercraft entering Wyoming Mar 1–Nov 30 need an AIS inspection. Mileage: preliminary NHDPlus V2 routed geometry (10.2 mi); no agency mileage found.

gaugeContext.note: Flow is measured below Willwood Dam. Diversions and tributaries can change discharge downstream; check current local conditions before launching.
